audit_notes: Verified date (Feb 19). 51st University Charter anniversary in 2026.

title: DLSU-College of Saint Benilde Foundation
founded_authority: Establishment of the College of Saint Benilde as an autonomous college within the De La Salle University System on October 25, 1988 (declared autonomous member institution in 1994)
audit_notes: Verified date (Oct 25). 38th founding anniversary in 2026.

title: DLSU Incorporation Anniversary
founded_authority: Official incorporation of De La Salle College as a non-stock, non-profit educational institution under the laws of the Philippine Islands on February 12, 1912
audit_notes: Verified date (Feb 12). 114th incorporation anniversary in 2026.

title: Taft Campus Transfer / St. La Salle Hall
founded_authority: Opening of classes at the new Taft Avenue campus and inauguration of St. La Salle Hall (designed by architect Tomas Mapua) on February 1, 1921 after moving from Calle Nozaleda, Paco
audit_notes: Verified date (Feb 1). 105th anniversary in 2026.
event: Taft Campus Transfer / St. La Salle Hall

title: Br. Andrew Gonzalez Birth Anniversary
rule: Born February 29 (Leap Day); commemorated on February 28 in non-leap years such as 2026
founded_authority: Birth of Br. Andrew Gonzalez FSC (1940–2006), linguist, educator, Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports (1998–2001), and 18th & 20th President of DLSU on February 29, 1940 in Manila
audit_notes: Because 2026 is a non-leap common year, Feb 29 birth anniversaries are canonically commemorated on Feb 28, 2026. 86th birth anniversary.

title: Feast of St. Mutien-Marie Wiaux
founded_authority: Canonized by Pope John Paul II on December 10, 1989; feast celebrated on January 30 (date of his death in Malonne, Belgium in 1917)
audit_notes: Verified date (Jan 30). Filled in 2026 date format, day of week (Friday), canonization authority (1989, 37th anniv; 109th of 1917 death).

title: DLSU Santiago Zobel Founding
rule: Celebrated annually in the DLS System (established 1978 in Ayala Alabang Village, Muntinlupa)
founded_authority: Established in 1978 through a donation of land by the Ayala Corporation and named in memory of Santiago Zobel; incorporated March 29, 1978
audit_notes: Verified date (Jan 1 / 1978). 48th founding anniversary in 2026.

title: Lasallian Mission Week
rule: Week surrounding the Feast of St. John Baptist de La Salle (May 15)
founded_authority: Established across the De La Salle Philippines network to celebrate Lasallian identity and founder's feast week
audit_notes: In 2026, May 15 is a Friday, making Lasallian Mission Week run from Monday May 11 to Sunday May 17, 2026.

title: Jose W. Diokno Birth Anniversary
founded_authority: Birth of Senator Jose Wright Diokno (1922–1987) on August 26, 1922 in Manila; DLSU High School and Commerce valedictorian/summa cum laude, human rights champion, founding chair of FLAG and CHR, namesake of the DLSU Tañada-Diokno School of Law
audit_notes: Verified date (Aug 26). 104th birth anniversary in 2026.
